Indikator 3 evaluates the quality of initial diagnostic workups for patients with [[atrieflimren]] by measuring the proportion who receive a [[thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh|thyreoideastimulerende hormon (TSH)]] test between 60 days prior to and 30 days following their first diagnosis date [^src2]. The clinical standard mandates that at least 95% of the incident population should receive this measurement, excluding patients without residency in Denmark [^src2]. 

Despite this clear benchmark, performance across Denmark's regions and healthcare clusters falls universally short. For the most recent reporting period (01.07.2023 – 30.06.2024), not a single entity met the ≥ 95% target [^src1]. The national aggregate reached only 76.0%, representing a slight downward trend from 76.7% in 2022/23 and 76.4% in 2021/22 [^src1]. 

Among the healthcare clusters, [[horsensklyngen|Horsensklyngen]] is the national leader, achieving 87.9% in the current year, though this marks a steady decline from 88.6% in 2022/23 and 90.1% in 2021/22 [^src1]. It is followed by [[sundhedsklynge-nord|Sundhedsklynge Nord]] at 82.0%, and both [[sundhedsklynge-fyn|Sundhedsklynge Fyn]] and [[randersklyngen|Randersklyngen]] at 81.6% [^src1]. At the broader regional level, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] leads the five regions with 81.2% [^src1]. 

Conversely, the lowest-performing entities highlight significant geographic disparities. [[sundhedsklynge-soenderjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sønderjylland]] ranks at the very bottom with 52.9%, followed by [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]] at 59.8% and [[sundhedsklyngen-slagelse|Sundhedsklyngen Slagelse]] at 66.4% [^src1]. 

Analyzing the three-year timeline reveals notable outliers and shifting trajectories. [[sundhedsklynge-nord|Sundhedsklynge Nord]] experienced a sharp decline, dropping from a high of 88.0% in 2022/23 to 82.0% in the current period [^src1]. In contrast, [[sundhedsklynge-soenderjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sønderjylland]] showed recent improvement, rising from 47.7% in 2022/23 to 52.9%, though it remains deeply entrenched as the national trailer, far below the 95% threshold [^src1]. Other regions, such as [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] (75.4%), [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] (75.6%), [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] (73.4%), and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] (72.5%), remain clustered in the mid-70s and low-70s, demonstrating stagnant performance well below the national standard [^src1].
